new_test.name: share_broker_heartbeat_interval_scheduling
asserts: Broker-directed multi-second interval (5000ms) on join schedules next share-protocol heartbeat at ~5000ms deadline, proving client no longer defaults to a 150ms loop
Subsequent broker response changing interval (60ms to 4000ms) is applied dynamically and moves next heartbeat deadline to ~4000ms
Invalid intervals (<= 0) on join are rejected with Error::Protocol
Invalid intervals (<= 0) on subsequent responses are safely classified into hb_err without spinning in a hot loop
Prompt leave/close cancels heartbeat task immediately (< 500ms) without waiting for 5000ms interval
Unsubscribe clears deadline and resets heartbeat interval to configuration default

limits: In-memory mock broker test; live multi-broker cluster was not exercised.
